title: Dense-subsite comparison for arbitrary small sieve sites
statement: Fix a universe $\mathcal V$ as in [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ be $\mathcal V$-small categories with sieve Grothendieck topologies $J,K$ and sheaf conditions as in [def-weil-pbc-topos], and let $u:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be a functor. For a sieve $R$ on $A\in\mathcal A$, write $u_*R$ for the sieve on $uA$ generated by the arrows $u(f)$ with $f\in R$. Assume: (1) for every $B\in\mathcal B$, the sieve of arrows into $B$ factoring through some object $uA$ is $K$-covering; (2) for every $g:uA\to uA'$, the sieve $R_g=\{f:T\to A:\ \exists h:T\to A',\ g\circ u(f)=u(h)\}$ has $u_*R_g$ $K$-covering; (3) for parallel $f,f':A\to A'$ with $u(f)=u(f')$, the sieve $R_{f,f'}=\{h:T\to A:\ f\circ h=f'\circ h\}$ has $u_*R_{f,f'}$ $K$-covering; (4) for every sieve $R$ on every $A$, $R$ is $J$-covering if and only if $u_*R$ is $K$-covering. Then restriction along $u^{\mathrm{op}}$ sends $K$-sheaves of $\mathcal V$-sets to $J$-sheaves of $\mathcal V$-sets and is an equivalence of categories. In particular $\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal A,J;\operatorname{Sets}_{\mathcal V})\simeq\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal B,K;\operatorname{Sets}_{\mathcal V})$. No pullbacks in either category and no subcanonicality are assumed.
